title: irlpls Quote (DRAFT)
description: The quote operation. A quote request is POSTed to {endpoint}/quotes; the response is a Quote holding one offer (a provider) or several (a router). Draft: docs/protocol/PROTOCOL-DRAFT.md.

request.description: An irlpls Request (STANDARD Section 4). It MUST NOT carry `policy`: the Policy stays with the requester or router. quantity is at most 10000.

constraints.description: Hard limits. A provider that cannot meet one makes no offer (it answers with a problem). A router checks offers against them again.

scene_nonce.description: The buyer's order nonce must be visible in the capture.

firm.description: true: the provider's own binding price until expires_at. false: indicative, from the card (a router's estimate); a paid order then needs a firm quote or a max_total.

rights.description: Rights this offer grants the buyer; absent = not granted.

proof.description: Levels deliveries under this offer will carry, per guarantee.

order_url.description: Where to POST the order. MUST be the provider card's protocol.endpoint + /orders (checked by the client). Required on a firm offer.

provider_quote_id.description: Router only: the id of the provider's own quote behind this offer. The client never orders the router's quote_id at the provider; it re-quotes at the provider with the exact request and orders that quote (STANDARD 14.11).

provider_quote_url.description: Router only: {provider endpoint}/quotes/{provider_quote_id}, where the client can read the provider's quote itself.

continue_url.description: A step only a person can take (sign-up, billing, KYC).

fit.description: Router only: per-request ranking aid (STANDARD 7). Never a provider property.

request_sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 form of the `request` member this quote request carried, as the server received it. An order of this quote's offer carries the same value, and so do its receipts.

questions.description: Non-blocking questions only; a blocking one is a needs_input problem.
